verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs say you can connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch and preview environments before production. The vercel/vercel GitHub README backs this up with "git push to deploy". missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of push-triggered deploys, and in-depth docs on trigger configuration (e.g., branch filters or ignored builds).

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch.
Connect your Git repository to deploy on every push, with automatic preview environments for testing changes before production.
